features.title: Map layers and loading status (from lisboa-3d)

A layer that is off is never downloaded; switching one on loads it without a reload, and its row says loading until its first tiles are asked for. Presets: Light (no optional layers) is the default on class S and P phones, Full on the rest; the choice is saved, and ?layers=light|full overrides it. A pill under the header counts the ring and MS tiles of the current camera move («Loading this area… 3 of 6»), then says «Area loaded», or «Map areas that failed to load: n» with Retry. The pill and the panel stay out of the history routes, the Azulejo game, story and cinema. pt, en and ru.

features.notes: How the room shows through a flat wall (the facade's windows are painted by the building shader): the room meshes draw first (renderOrder -2), then an invisible quad 4 cm in front of the wall writes depth over the opening (renderOrder -1, colorWrite off, no polygon offset: at a slant an offset pulls it ~30 cm forward and hides the glass), so the wall loses the depth test there. The room is a closed box, so every ray through the opening ends on it. No stencil: the canvas and the composer target have none. The room's materials (MeshStandardMaterial patched in onBeforeCompile, one program key) drop the scene's sun, sky and environment light and take three lamps in view space (screens, curtain, window daylight); intensities depend on atmosphere.night. Placement (pickFacade): the edge whose outward normal best follows the line from `corner` through the footprint centre, at least 6.4 m long; the window sits on the facade shader's 1.6 m mullion grid (aWall.x runs from vertex 0) and on the modern style's floor grid (3.6 m ground floor, 3.0 m floors).
